fix.OVER_PAYLOAD: take only {{fit}} pieces, or carry it on a bigger truck.
fix.NO_SPACE: take fewer pieces, or carry it on another trip with more free space.
fix.TOO_LARGE: it needs a longer or taller truck.
fix.OFF_CORRIDOR: ask the shipper to bring it closer to your route — it is {{km}} km away.
fix.WRONG_DIRECTION: offer it to a trip going the other way.
